note: Surveys results on the proportion of zeta zeros that are both simple and on the critical line, up to the unconditional 67.25% bound that Anthropic reported an unreleased Claude model obtained by linking a pair-correlation approach to a 2000 paper of Bombieri, and Lamzouri's conceptually simpler proof. It explains why such proportions would not settle the Riemann hypothesis.
title: Simple and critical zeros of the Riemann zeta-function
who: Caroline Turnage-Butterbaugh (Carleton College); guest post on Terence Tao's blog
